title: The Rosie Project
author: Graeme Simsion
summary: A socially awkward genetics professor designs a questionnaire to find the perfect wife. Instead he meets a woman who fails every criterion and enlists his help to find her biological father.
readIf: you like a literal-minded, hapless hero and a romantic comedy that is clever about its own formulas.
skipIf: you are put off by a narrator whose behaviour reads as autistic but is never named, or by neat, light-hearted resolutions.

pairings.reason: Another romance built on a scientist's careful plan going gleefully off course.
Flips the idea, with a heroine who treats romance as a problem to be practised and solved.
A more poignant story about a person who finds the rules of social life baffling.
